scores.note: All drop 'also' and most turn 'connected to' into represents/symbolizes. 1 generalises 'rich and happy' to 'succeed'. 2 and 4 open with an ambiguous 'It' and an awkward 'the American Dream that...'. 5 drops 'anyone'.
